name: Nakau

gf.best: お子様カレー丼ぶり (kids' curry bowl — 豚肉● and nothing else). Otherwise ライス + 銀鮭（単品） + 彩り野菜サラダ + 紅生姜.
gf.detail: The most hostile kitchen of the four, and the only one where even the miso soup fails. Nakau's own アレルゲン一覧表 (Zensho, 更新日2026年8月19日) shows 小麦「●」 on every 丼 (牛すき丼, 親子丼, カツ丼, 牛とじ丼, 鶏から丼, まぐろ丼, うな重), every 和風カレー, both 定食, all four 朝食 — AND on みそ汁 #91 (小麦●・さば●・大豆●), つけもの #84, のり #102, 納豆 #100, きつねあげ #108 and 旨だし醤油. Nakau is also an udon/soba house, and the sheet carries two disclosures the other three do not: 「うどんとそばを同じ調理器具（湯）で茹でております」 (udon and soba boiled in the same water) and 「揚げ物は同一の揚げ油を使用して調理しております」 (one shared fryer). A reactive celiac is standing in a room where wheat noodles are boiled continuously. What IS wheat-free on the sheet: お子様カレー丼ぶり #122 — the entire 28-column row is dashes except 豚肉● (a low-allergen kids' roux; the adult 和風カレー #32 is 小麦●); ライス #88 and 彩り野菜サラダ #93 and 紀州南高梅 #115 and すだち #117 and 紅生姜 and 山椒 (zero of 28); 銀鮭（単品）#101 (さけ●さば△); とろろ（単品）#99 (やまいも● only); こだわり卵/温たま #89-90; ベーコン #87; 追加チーズ #111. 具だくさんとん汁 #92 is 小麦△ (cross-contact only), unlike the plain miso soup.

vegan.best: — (at best ライス + 彩り野菜サラダ + とろろ + 紀州南高梅 + すだち + 紅生姜)
vegan.detail: Nothing plant-based is sold and no tofu dish exists on the menu. The only rows carrying no animal allergen are ライス, 彩り野菜サラダ, 紀州南高梅, すだち, 紅生姜, 山椒 and とろろ（単品）. Everything that would make a meal is built on animal stock or egg: 親子丼 is Nakau's signature and is chicken and egg; the うどん/そば tsuyu is 小麦・さば; きつねあげ (the vegetarian-looking fried tofu pouch) is 小麦●大豆● and is simmered in dashi; and かつお節オクラ is literally bonito flakes despite its blank allergen row — a perfect illustration that dashi and かつお節 are invisible to Japan's 28-item list. No vegan should plan a meal here.

both_gf_and_vegan: Only as a side plate: ライス + 彩り野菜サラダ + とろろ + 紀州南高梅 + すだち + 紅生姜 are all wheat-free and all free of every listed animal allergen. It is not a meal, and it is assembled in a kitchen that boils soba. The wheat-free お子様カレー丼ぶり contains pork.
caveats: Every 丼, every うどん, every そば, both 定食 and all four 朝食 are 小麦● — wheat as an ingredient.
Nakau's みそ汁 is 小麦● — unlike Sukiya, Matsuya and Yoshinoya, whose miso soups are wheat-free. Do not assume miso soup is safe here.
「うどんとそばを同じ調理器具（湯）で茹でております」 — udon and soba share the same boiling water. A gluten-heavy kitchen by design.
「揚げ物は同一の揚げ油を使用して調理しております」 — one shared fryer (海老天ぷら, 鶏から).
つけもの (the pickles) and のり and 納豆 are all 小麦●. 旨だし醤油 at the counter is 小麦●大豆●.
紅生姜, 山椒, 紀州南高梅 and すだち carry none of the 28 allergens — the clean condiments.
かつお節オクラ shows a blank allergen row but is bonito flakes. Blank ≠ vegan: かつお節 and dashi are not listed allergens in Japan.
お子様カレー丼ぶり is a children's item; the SET version (#128) is 小麦△ because of what comes with it.

phrases.ja: 小麦アレルギーです。うどんとそばを同じ湯で茹でていますか？
phrases.romaji: Komugi arerugii desu. Udon to soba o onaji yu de yudete imasu ka?
phrases.en: I have a wheat allergy. Are the udon and soba boiled in the same water?

phrases.ja: ライスと銀鮭の単品と彩り野菜サラダをください。みそ汁は小麦が入っているので抜いてください。
phrases.romaji: Raisu to ginzake no tanpin to irodori-yasai sarada o kudasai. Misoshiru wa komugi ga haitte iru node nuite kudasai.
phrases.en: Rice, the single grilled salmon and the vegetable salad, please. No miso soup — it contains wheat.

phrases.ja: お子様カレー丼ぶりは小麦不使用と表示されています。注文できますか？
phrases.romaji: Okosama-karee donburi wa komugi-fushiyou to hyouji sarete imasu. Chuumon dekimasu ka?
phrases.en: The kids' curry bowl is listed as wheat-free. May I order it?

phrases.ja: だしやかつお節が入っていない料理はありますか？
phrases.romaji: Dashi ya katsuobushi ga haitte inai ryouri wa arimasu ka?
phrases.en: Is there anything with no dashi or bonito flakes in it?
